✨ 𝐈 𝐥𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐡. 👇

One of my buyers was ready to make an offer on a home that had been sitting on the market for a few weeks.

She asked:
👉 “Should I offer $15k below the list price? Or offer full price and ask the seller to cover $15k in closing costs?”

✨ Here’s what we figured out together:

Both offers would look the same to the seller — but they’d feel ᴠᴇʀʏ different to her monthly payment and her pocketbook.

👉 If she offered $15k under asking, she’d save about $80/month on her payment.
👉 If she offered full price and used that $15k to buy down her rate + cover closing costs, she could save $200+/month AND keep more cash on hand after closing.

Same house. Same net to the seller. 𝐖𝐚𝐲 𝐛𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫 outcome for her.

Right now, strategy is ᴇᴠᴇʀʏᴛʜɪɴɢ when writing offers — especially in a market where buyers are payment-conscious.

We ended up writing full price with concessions. 🤞 Now we wait!

If you want me running these numbers for 𝐘𝐎𝐔𝐑 next purchase — you know where to find me. 💬📲
